entities.title: Replay check
entities.summary: A web game's Worker replays a submitted game from its seed and recorded controls, and ranks the score the replay reaches, not the one the browser claims.
entities.details: This is why the engines must be deterministic (AGENTS.md). Each game's glossary defines its own seed.

entities.title: games:play
entities.summary: The icelander.net role a player needs to open a web game and use its API.

entities.title: Changed game
entities.summary: A game with a package.json that a change touches outside its .dev folders; a change under .github/, outside .github/.dev, changes every game.

entities.title: Migration acknowledgement
entities.summary: A ticked line in a pull request's description saying production's database was migrated, or that no migration is needed; the migration gate looks for it.

entities.title: The owner
entities.summary: The person who decides what goes live and answers open decisions; see Actors/owner.md.
